scope: A narrow isolated source-H/functional-group ownership trace with pinned exact source; compare selected and rejected parses without production integration.
supplied_capability: Test whether grammar node, source span/clone lineage, owner fragment, and same-result CML atom can be linked reliably for a bounded class.
existing_work: Reuse prior isolated R/S trace; do not repeat it as a new finding.
blockers: alias claim specificity as a separate downstream task
criteria_accept: pin matching source revision and artifact provenance
prove source span -> selected parse node -> fragment -> atom with clone/transform lineage
validate symmetry and ambiguity with explicit abstention
match independent positive, negative, underspecified and conflicting source constraints
preserve warnings and reject trace when provenance is incomplete
criteria_reject: fallback ordering or default silently presented as explicit
missing original-token lineage or graph correspondence
any historical unsafe source elevated to exact
limits: No expectation that this covers all nomenclature classes; FixedH and parser consensus cannot prove source semantics.
commercial_next: If an existing license is later available, run same blind challenge against OpenEye atom locant fields; ask vendor about source occurrence and ownership.
